item.title: Show HN: Learn how to count Mahjong points/fan/tai
item.summary: Many Mahjong counting applications want to count the fan/tai/points for you, but why not being cool and learn something about the game you love so much. Learn how to count Taiwan or Hong Kong Style Mahjong winning hands and show off on your next game :) Enjoy and let the counting controversy begin! :D Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49240617 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
